headline: Waters (WAT) After Recurring Revenue Strength, Is The Valuation Still Compelling?
summary: Waters (WAT) is back on investor radars after recent trading highlighted its role in analytical instruments and software used across pharmaceuticals, chemicals, and environmental testing. This has prompted a closer look at its valuation and fundamentals. See our latest analysis for Waters. At a share price of US$374.68, Waters has seen short term volatility, with the share price slipping 2.02% over the last day but gaining 24.98% over 90 days.
